“Yes,” he nodded. “Though it is not known outside my family, I adopted her when she was a baby. It is strange that you should know this. But I am not interested in having you tell me what I have long since known. What I want to know now is: where is she now?”

Yi Poon gravely and sympathetically shook his head.

I know.”", "sha256": "1e8090df8b1356f20cd31b71b047813c88105a1ff241d7ba244c715cfb5ad29f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2084]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u024-r0069", "tag": "p", "text": "And old Enrico Solano could not hide his interest at the temptation of such information.", "sha256": "1be35b559c0354317a284edf20619184972107026594dbef65763dc622d68760", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2085]", "source_html": "

And old Enrico Solano could not hide his interest at the temptation of such information.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u024-r0070", "tag": "p", "text": "“Speak,” he commanded. “Name the names, and prove them, and I shall reward.”", "sha256": "d1eb4d4cdcaddd2cdf4b6bfd7987835e1978fd1658ea484b11cef5834a3ba3e7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2086]", "source_html": "

I prove my secrets. You give me five hundred pesos and big expenses from Colon to San Antonio and back to Colon and I tell you name of papa and mama.”", "sha256": "f8ffd6adeadd122f6dbfefd038f8e0275fcfdc4d41330525dbbdae75b5f6e810", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2087]", "source_html": "

Running into the room and up to Enrico as they had never seen her run before, she wrung her hands and wept so incoherently that they knew her paroxysm was of joy, not of sadness.", "sha256": "be28a2be3dc1beddce988a087883659612c16f3a3da75144248392d97a809121", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2088]", "source_html": "

Running into the room and up to Enrico as they had never seen her run before, she wrung her hands and wept so incoherently that they knew her paroxysm was of joy, not of sadness.

Enrico and his sons streamed out to the side piazza to behold Leoncia and the Queen and the two Morgans, dropping dust-covered off the backs of riding mules recognizable as from the pastures of the mouth of the Gualaca River. At the same time two Indian man-servants, summoned by the maid, cleared the house and grounds of the fat Chinaman and his old crone of a companion.", "sha256": "e6af962d6d1012aaa23dbcb3d0d581750f14934735398512add629dc8f794dd7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2090]", "source_html": "

And Yi Poon and his secret were forgotten. At the same time two Indian man-servants, summoned by the maid, cleared the house and grounds of the fat Chinaman and his old crone of a companion.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u024-r0075", "tag": "p", "text": "“Come some other time,” they told him. “Just now the Senor Solano is very importantly busy.”", "sha256": "1c220e581030c33dc7bebd03ec81c89724663c4815cc57c5fdcb91dcaa926c75", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2091]", "source_html": "

“Sure, I come some other time,” Yi Poon assured them pleasantly, without resentment and without betrayal of the disappointment that was his at his deal interrupted just ere the money was paid into his hand.

Never was there a riper harvest in Canaan out of which, sickle in hand, a husbandman was driven! Had it not been for the zealous Indian attendants, Yi Poon would have darted around the corner of the hacienda to note the newcomers. Enrico swept Leoncia off her mule ere she could dismount, so passionately eager was he to fold her in his arms. For several minutes ensued naught but noisy Latin affection as her brothers all strove to greet and embrace her at once. When they recollected themselves, Francis had already helped the Lady Who Dreams from her mount, and beside her, her hand in his, was waiting recognition.
